name: VT secondary star-point identification
summary: Shows the common neutral of the documented phase-voltage secondary arrangement.
description: Shows the common neutral of the documented phase-voltage secondary arrangement. A voltage-transformer secondary arrangement connects a defined primary voltage measurement to protection, metering or control inputs. Winding identity, fuse protection and the voltage reference must remain visible across the drawing.

In a substation bay, one voltage circuit can feed protection while a separately identified winding supplies metering. A voltage-selection circuit must make clear which bus or line measurement is being used. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Phase voltage windings” at the input and “Secondary neutral reference” at the output. The neutral connection must not be assumed.

Show the primary measurement point, secondary connection, protective devices and relay reference. A missing measurement can resemble a real system disturbance unless the voltage-circuit health is supervised appropriately. The functional block is an independent explanation of this named application. Equipment-specific ratings, terminal connections and operating conditions must be established in the project documentation.
